_note: Where a ticket is in the process, derived from what GitHub can prove. Four stages are derived from PRs and cannot drift; two need a label because no machine can see a person looking. Evaluated top to bottom on an OPEN ticket; the LAST rule whose test is true wins, so later rows are 'further along'. A project overrides in <project>/.cockpit/plugins/github.stages.json. Label names are the project's own vocabulary.

stages.title: In progress
stages.rule: claimed by a coder (label), no PR yet

stages.title: In review
stages.rule: a PR is open for it

stages.title: In UAT
stages.rule: a PR merged; on main, not yet verified

stages.title: Verified
stages.rule: a person confirmed it in UAT (label)
